_comment: SPOILER İÇERİR. Save Inventory codes → display names, for rule work and the diagnostics (the patch locres has no names for these codes). Key: the code as it appears in Inventory.MainWeaponInfos / ShaChiWeaponInfo / AccessoryInfos / InventoryInfos (lib/state.js items). en: official English name; tr: Turkish name from the Turkish patch (title-cased), or null when not certain (the UI then shows English); guess: false everywhere since 2026-11-09: every mapping was verified against the game tables (data/game/, built by research/gamedata; source "game-data", gameKey = the Game.locres key). Not bundled into the web build (the page only shows codes).

LuanYing.note: Main weapon. The sword on the pier after Mu Xiaokui (Village of Lu, before the lift); rule lu-elevator-sword.

YuuBlade.note: Main weapon, Mu Xiaokui's reward (acquired just before LuanYing). Fiend Saws is likely (the five-ribbon reward) but not verified. 2026-11-09: confirmed by the game table (DataTable row name key Weapon_023).

KuYeSiZhuChuan.note: Sha-chi weapon (Phantom Edge), from Bi Hai.

CaoOuSiXian.note: Sha-chi weapon (Phantom Edge) acquired after the Dusk fight; the name is a guess. 2026-11-09: confirmed by the game table (DataTable row name key PhantomEdges_025).

AC_ResistRanged.note: Accessory, the wounded thief's reward for the Thief's Manual; rule lu-wounded-thief-manual (doneWhen).
